issue.title: Debounce color-picker theme updates
issue.description:
Improve color-picker performance by decoupling immediate picker interaction from expensive global theme/preview updates.

Observed issue:

* While dragging inside the color picker, every tiny pointer movement immediately triggers a full theme mutation and preview update.
* This creates excessive re-rendering and makes the picker feel sluggish/janky during continuous movement.

Owner direction:

* Keep the color-picker UI responsive and visually immediate while dragging.
* Delay the expensive theme/preview mutation until pointer movement pauses briefly.
* Treat this as a performance/interaction polish only; do not change the canonical color model.

Desired interaction model:

```
pointer moves continuously
→ picker UI follows immediately
→ no full global theme update yet

pointer pauses briefly
→ commit latest color
→ update theme/preview once
```

Implementation guidance:

* Use a short debounce for the global theme mutation, approximately 100–150 ms as a starting point.
* The worker should tune the exact value based on current rendering cost and perceived responsiveness rather than blindly hard-coding a number.
* Local picker state/visual feedback should remain immediate.
* The committed theme value must always converge to the latest selected color after movement stops.
* A pointer-up/end-of-drag should flush the latest pending value immediately rather than waiting unnecessarily.
* Keyboard/manual numeric/text color edits should preserve appropriate immediate behavior unless they share the same high-frequency update problem.

History/recovery integration:

* One continuous color drag should create one meaningful undo/history checkpoint, not many debounce commits.
* Intermediate local picker states must not pollute canonical history.
* Undo/redo/reset semantics from <issue id="4158e066-ff2a-4426-a776-21651ac85d39" href="https://linear.app/emman-systems/issue/PUI-3/manual-editing-history-and-recovery">PUI-3</issue> must remain correct.
* Dirty state should reflect the final committed color value.

Preserve:

* current color formats and normalization;
* current semantic color-token behavior;
* current picker visuals and interaction affordances;
* accessibility and keyboard behavior;
* Design Command boundaries;
* import/export/persistence semantics.

Do not:

* change canonical Theme v3 color schema;
* reduce color precision;
* introduce stale/out-of-order commits;
* lose the final selected color if the user drags quickly and releases;
* debounce unrelated low-frequency theme controls unless evidence shows the same performance issue.

Scope:

* Workbench color-picker interaction and mutation pipeline.
* History coalescing integration for color drags.
* Relevant tests/browser verification.

Acceptance:

* Color-picker drag interaction feels materially smoother.
* Picker UI updates immediately while dragging.
* Full theme/preview updates occur only after a short movement pause or drag end.
* Final committed color always matches the latest picker position.
* Pointer-up flushes any pending final color promptly.
* One continuous drag produces one undo/history checkpoint.
* No stale commit can overwrite a newer selected color.
* No regressions to color import/export, persistence, dirty state, undo/redo/reset, accessibility, or semantic token rendering.
